settings.heading:
The standards
behind MUTO
settings.lede: Supplements don’t have to prove much to go on sale in the UK. So we built MUTO to a higher bar, and we show you all of it: every dose on the label, every batch tested, made in the UK.

settings.title: Every dose on the label
settings.text: No proprietary blends. Every one of the 19 ingredients is listed with its exact dose and form, so you know exactly what you’re taking.
settings.check: Read the full label on our ingredients page, or turn the jar round.

settings.title: Doses chosen for a reason
settings.text: NR at 300mg, the most allowed in Great Britain. Vitamin D3 at 2,000 IU. B vitamins in their active, methylated forms. Zinc and copper dosed as a pair, because they compete for absorption. Nothing added just to make the list longer.
settings.check: Every dose and form is in the ingredient table.

settings.title: Only UK-authorised ingredients
settings.text: Every ingredient in MUTO is authorised for use in UK food supplements. That’s why we use NR rather than NMN, which is still under assessment.

settings.title: Every batch third-party tested
settings.text: Not just the first batch. Every batch is tested by an independent lab before it’s released.

settings.title: Made in the UK, to GMP
settings.text: Manufactured in the UK to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) standards, in an ISO-certified facility.

settings.title: Nothing you don’t need
settings.text: Vegan capsules made from plant cellulose (HPMC). Vitamin D3 from algae. No major allergens, no fillers, no caffeine and no stimulants.

settings.title: Scientists with names
settings.text: Formulated by Dr Richie Barclay, PhD in cell biology and nutrition, with a six-member scientific advisory board. The board meets every quarter to guide our research and every new formula. It doesn’t endorse products.
settings.check: Meet the board on our About page.

settings.title: Research we’ll publish
settings.text: A University of Westminster study starts in December 2026, with work at King’s College London, Coventry and Newcastle to follow. There are no results yet, and we’ll never say there are.
settings.check: We’ll share every update on this page.

settings.title: Honest claims only
settings.text: We only make the health claims UK law authorises, worded exactly. We’ll tell you what MUTO won’t do as clearly as what it will. Every review is genuine, and every creator we work with is disclosed.
settings.check: Every claim on our site carries its authorised wording.

settings.title: Built to be checked
settings.text: Note how you feel today. Give it 90 days. If you don’t feel the difference, you get every subscription payment back. Skip, pause or cancel online anytime, with a reminder five days before every payment.

settings.title: Can I see your test results?
settings.text: Yes. Batch certificates are available on request: hello@mutolongevity.com.

settings.title: Why NR and not NMN?
settings.text: NR is authorised for food supplements in Great Britain, at up to 300mg a day for adults. NMN is still under novel food assessment.

settings.title: Has MUTO been clinically proven?
settings.text: No, and we won’t say it has. Our first human study starts in December 2026 at the University of Westminster. We’ll publish the results, whatever they show.

settings.title: Is it tested for banned substances?
settings.text: Every batch is third-party tested. We don’t currently make a banned-substance certification claim, and we’ll update this page if that changes.

settings.title: Is it safe with medication?
settings.text: Check with your GP or pharmacist first. MUTO contains vitamin K2, which can affect blood thinners such as warfarin.
